map.植物修剪时期对照表 使用指南: Plant Pruning Season Comparison Table User Guide
map.按花前、花后、休眠期等修剪时机筛选植物，查看各类花木的最佳修剪时期与操作要点，避: Filter plants by pruning timing such as before flowering, after flowering or the dormant season, and see the best period and key points for each type, to avoid mistimed cuts that hurt flowering and growth.
map.按开花习性定时：老枝开花的种类（大花绣球、杜鹃等）必须在花后、且多在 8 月前完: Time it by flowering habit: old-wood flowering types (large-flowered hydrangea, azalea and similar) must be pruned after flowering and mostly before August, or the buds formed the previous autumn for the following year get cut off and the plant flowers not at all; new-wood flowering types (panicle and oakleaf hydrangea) flower on the current season's new shoots, so even a hard dormant-season prune does not affect flowering.
map.休眠期重剪：紫薇、石榴、葡萄、苹果/梨、桃树等在落叶后至早春萌芽前短截一年生枝条: Heavy dormant-season pruning: crape myrtle, pomegranate, grape, apple/pear, peach and similar trees have their one-year-old shoots cut back after leaf fall and before early-spring bud break, which encourages new shoots and makes shaping and thinning easier; with no leaves you can see the branch structure clearly and wounds heal fast. The tool covers 6 plants in this category.
map.花后轻剪与禁忌：月季每次花后剪除残花可促二次花，冬季再重剪至 3-5 芽；玉兰花: Light pruning after flowering and the cautions: remove the spent flowers after each flush of roses to encourage a second flush, then prune hard back to 3-5 buds in winter; after flowering on magnolia only remove diseased and crossing branches and avoid heavy pruning (wounds heal slowly); osmanthus and jasmine flower before pruning, so shape them in spring and remove inward-growing branches instead.
map.操作示例：18 种植物按三档筛选查看修剪期: Operating example: filter 18 plants across the three tiers to see their pruning periods
map.：页面收录 18 种常见花木，按修剪期分为三档：花后修剪 10 种（月季、绣球·: The page covers 18 common plants in three pruning-season groups: 10 pruned after flowering (rose, hydrangea old-wood flowering, magnolia, winter jasmine, plum, camellia, azalea, crabapple, climbing rose, gardenia), 6 pruned in the dormant season (crape myrtle, hydrangea new-wood flowering, pomegranate, grape, apple/pear, peach) and 2 pruned before flowering (osmanthus, jasmine). Click the "All / Before flowering / After flowering / Dormant season" tabs at the top to filter by group, and each card gives the specific period and key points (for example rose: "light-prune the spent flowers after each flush, prune hard back to 3-5 buds in the winter dormant season"; large-flowered hydrangea: "finish pruning before August, after which the buds form and no pruning is allowed from autumn to the following spring").
map.为什么绣球要区分老枝开花和新枝开花？: Why Do Hydrangeas Distinguish Old-Wood and New-Wood Flowering?
map.大花绣球在头年长成的老枝上形成花芽，秋季至翌春修剪会直接剪掉花芽、当年无花，所以: Large-flowered hydrangeas form their flower buds on old wood grown the previous year, so pruning from autumn to the following spring cuts the buds directly and the plant flowers not at all that year, which means pruning must be finished after flowering and before August. Panicle and oakleaf hydrangeas flower on newly grown shoots, so a hard prune in early spring does not affect that year's flowering and can even renew the plant's shape. Confirming which type the variety belongs to before buying or taking care of it is the first step in deciding the pruning season.
map.休眠期修剪具体指哪一段时间？: Which Period Exactly Is the Dormant Season?
map.指植株落叶后到早春萌芽之前（大致 1-3 月，南方相应提前）。此时树液流动缓慢、: It refers to the period after leaf fall and before early-spring bud break (roughly January to March, earlier in warmer southern regions). At this time sap flow is slow, wounds heal easily, the lack of leaves makes branch structure easier to judge, and diseased, pest and crossing branches can be removed. Pruning in severe cold risks frost damage at the cut, so finish before temperatures recover; evergreen species and those with heavy bleeding flow (such as grape) must avoid the bleeding period around bud break.
